k:HH.Inn.Arrival.Day: They have come for the day.
k:HH.Inn.Arrival.Label: Guests: {0}
k:HH.Inn.Arrival.Overnight: They want to stay the night.
k:HH.Inn.Arrival.Text: {0} from {1} have arrived. {2} Between them they carry about {3} silver.
k:HH.Inn.Arrival.TipDesk: Tip: a front desk lets guests check in properly; without one they find their beds themselves.
k:HH.Inn.Concierge.AllClear: all clear, the guests are content.
k:HH.Inn.Desk.NoBeds: No guest beds yet: mark a bed as guest bed to receive overnight guests.
k:HH.Inn.Door.AllowAll: Let everyone in (ignore all filters below)
k:HH.Inn.Door.GizmoDesc: Choose who may stay: factions, xenotypes, gender, age, royal titles, tech level, wealth and kind of stay. Filters apply when guests are planned and generated.
k:HH.Inn.Door.Intro: Who may come. Filters apply when guests are planned and generated; hostile factions never visit.
k:HH.Inn.Door.Preview: {0} of people from friendly factions would be welcome.
k:HH.Inn.Door.Quip.Gender: Half the world uninvited. Efficient, you sexist.
k:HH.Inn.Door.Quip.Tech: Too primitive for your fine dining? Noted.
k:HH.Inn.Door.Quip.Title: Class warfare, but make it hospitality.
k:HH.Inn.Door.Quip.Wealth: Only the rich. Your landlord would be proud.
k:HH.Inn.Door.Title: Door policy
k:HH.Inn.Event.BedTaken: Lost the bed in the middle of the stay.
k:HH.Inn.Event.BondTooLow: Liked the place, but not enough to stay (bond {0}/{1}).
k:HH.Inn.Event.CheckedIn: Checked in at the front desk.
k:HH.Inn.Event.CouldNotPay: Could not pay for the night.
k:HH.Inn.Event.Declined: Thought about staying for good, then went home.
k:HH.Inn.Event.GotRoom: Took a bed in a {0} for {1} silver a night.
k:HH.Inn.Event.HonestyBox: Checked in at the honesty box; nobody was on duty.
k:HH.Inn.Event.HonestyPrice: Paid the honesty-box price of {0} silver a night.
k:HH.Inn.Event.Joined: Decided to stay and joined the colony.
k:HH.Inn.Event.LeftBroke: Left early: the money ran out.
k:HH.Inn.Event.NoBed: Could not get an affordable bed and stayed for the day only.
k:HH.Inn.Event.PaidFirstNight: Paid {0} silver for the first night ({1}).
k:HH.Inn.Event.RecruitTalk: Had a long talk with {0} about staying.
k:HH.Inn.Event.SelfCheckIn: Found the room alone; nobody was at a desk.
k:HH.Inn.Event.SharedBed: Shares the bed with {0} ({1} silver a night extra).
k:HH.Inn.Event.ShortenedStay: Shortened the stay to {0} night(s) to afford the room.
k:HH.Inn.Event.TooImportant: Too important at home to stay.
k:HH.Inn.Event.Welcomed: Was welcomed at the front desk by {0}.
k:HH.Inn.GuestBed.Desc: Rent this bed to guests. Colonists will not sleep here; guests only sleep in guest beds. The price per night follows the room, the bed and how many beds share the room.
k:HH.Inn.GuestBed.Inactive: Guest bed (inactive while medical, prisoner or slave bed)
k:HH.Inn.GuestBed.Label: Guest bed
k:HH.Inn.GuestBed.NotColonistBed: Only a normal colonist bed (not medical, prisoner or slave) can be a guest bed.
k:HH.Inn.Handling.AccompanyDesc: Colonists with Hosting work keep this guest company: better mood, better ratings. Costs colonist time. Falls back to basics when nobody can host.
k:HH.Inn.Handling.BasicsDesc: Paid services only, no entertainment. Costs no colonist time.
k:HH.Inn.Handling.Click: Click to switch: Basics → Accompany → Recruit.
k:HH.Inn.Handling.Label: Handling: {0}
k:HH.Inn.Handling.RecruitDesc: Like Accompany, plus talks about staying. If the colony's bond with the guest is strong enough, they may join at departure. Pushy talks can offend.
k:HH.Inn.Leaving.Closing: Going home: the venues are closing
k:HH.Inn.Leaving.Money: Leaving early: the money ran out
k:HH.Inn.Leaving.Removal: Going home: the Inn module was switched off
k:HH.Inn.Leaving.Temperature: Leaving early: the temperature was dangerous
k:HH.Inn.Leaving.Unhappy: Leaving early: unhappy with the stay
k:HH.Inn.Leaving.Wounded: Leaving early: carrying the wounded home
k:HH.Inn.Msg.FirstGuestsEta: Your first guests are on their way: {0}, expected {1}.
k:HH.Inn.Msg.Insulted: {0} found the recruiting pushy and will spend less and leave sooner.
k:HH.Inn.Msg.LeavingTemperature: Your guests from {0} are leaving: it is dangerously hot or cold.
k:HH.Inn.Msg.LeavingWounded: Your guests from {0} are taking their wounded home.
k:HH.Inn.Msg.WingCreated: {0} created around your guest bed. Guests stay inside it. Adjust it with the guest wing tools in the Hospitality menu.
k:HH.Inn.Msg.WingGrown: {0} now reaches {1}: guests can walk there.
k:HH.Inn.PriceMode.GizmoDesc: Change the price of this bed: free (for friends and recruits), 25 % off, the automatic price, or 25 % more. Applies to the next booking.
k:HH.Inn.Problem.Bored: Bored: add recreation to the guest wing (TV, chess, a venue).
k:HH.Inn.Problem.BoredMany: {0} guests are bored: add recreation to the guest wing.
k:HH.Inn.Problem.Broke: Almost out of money: will leave early.
k:HH.Inn.Problem.BrokeMany: {0} guests are almost out of money.
k:HH.Inn.Problem.Cold: Too cold ({0}): heat the guest wing.
k:HH.Inn.Problem.ColdMany: {0} guests are too cold: heat the guest wing.
k:HH.Inn.Problem.Hot: Too hot ({0}): cool the guest wing with coolers.
k:HH.Inn.Problem.HotMany: {0} guests are too hot: cool the guest wing with coolers.
k:HH.Inn.Problem.Hungry: Hungry: stock a restaurant or tavern with meals (open, staffed).
k:HH.Inn.Problem.HungryMany: {0} guests are hungry: stock a restaurant or tavern with meals.
k:HH.Inn.Problem.Insulted: Felt pestered by recruiting: switch the handling to Accompany.
k:HH.Inn.Problem.InsultedMany: {0} guests felt pestered: recruit less pushily.
k:HH.Inn.Problem.MoodMany: {0} guests are in a bad mood (see their Guest tab).
k:HH.Inn.Problem.NoBed: Has no bed: mark another guest bed, or make one cheaper.
k:HH.Inn.Problem.NoBedMany: {0} guests have no bed: mark more guest beds or make them cheaper.
k:HH.Inn.Problem.Pricey: Finds {0} silver a night steep: give the bed a lower price (−25 %) or a better room.
k:HH.Inn.Problem.PriceyMany: {0} guests find their rooms too expensive: lower bed prices or improve the rooms.
k:HH.Inn.Problem.Waited: Waited in vain for service: give your venues staff (Serving work).
k:HH.Inn.Problem.WaitedMany: {0} guests waited in vain: give your venues staff (Serving work).
k:HH.Inn.Recruit.Insulted: felt pestered: will not join this time
k:HH.Inn.Recruit.TooImportant: too important at home to join
k:HH.Inn.Report.Hostile: They left as enemies. No tip.
k:HH.Inn.Report.Label: Guests left: {0}
k:HH.Inn.Report.LeftBroke: Their money ran out before their stay did.
k:HH.Inn.Report.LeftEarly: They left before their planned day.
k:HH.Inn.Report.Opener.bad.0: The guests from {FACTION} left with a list. It was not a shopping list.
k:HH.Inn.Report.Opener.bad.1: {NAME} promised to tell everyone about the {ROOM}. That is the problem.
k:HH.Inn.Report.Opener.bad.2: A stay to forget, if {FACTION} lets anyone forget it.
k:HH.Inn.Report.Opener.fine.0: The guests from {FACTION} left. It happened, and that is about all.
k:HH.Inn.Report.Opener.fine.1: A stay of the kind nobody writes home about. {NAME} wrote home anyway.
k:HH.Inn.Report.Opener.fine.2: {NAME} rated the {ROOM} "a room". Hard to argue.
k:HH.Inn.Report.Opener.good.0: The guests from {FACTION} left content and only slightly lighter in the purse.
k:HH.Inn.Report.Opener.good.1: A pleasant stay. Nobody complained loudly enough to count.
k:HH.Inn.Report.Opener.good.2: {NAME} called the {ROOM} "honest", which from {FACTION} is a compliment.
k:HH.Inn.Report.Opener.great.0: The guests from {FACTION} left glowing. One of them hugged the doorframe.
k:HH.Inn.Report.Opener.great.1: {FACTION} will be talking about this stay for a while, mostly in a good way.
k:HH.Inn.Report.Opener.great.2: A flawless stay. {NAME} asked whether the {ROOM} could be booked again "for life".
k:HH.Inn.Report.Opener.poor.0: The guests from {FACTION} left early in spirit and on time in body.
k:HH.Inn.Report.Opener.poor.1: {NAME} described the {ROOM} with a word our clerk refused to write down.
k:HH.Inn.Report.Opener.poor.2: Not a disaster. Not a stay you would put on a sign, either.
